title: Celebrations, Dates, and Rules
summary: Festivals, dates, congratulations, and rules in everyday life.
whyItMatters: Celebrations combine dates, invitations, gifts, food, social expectations, and good wishes. Knowing the event vocabulary and basic rules helps you participate appropriately and understand what guests should do.

mentalModel.title: Build an event card
mentalModel.content: For every celebration, identify the occasion, date, time, place, host, guests, and any requested action.

mentalModel.title: Separate custom from rule
mentalModel.content: A custom describes what people often do; a rule or instruction states what guests must, should, or must not do.

mentalModel.title: Move through the event
mentalModel.content: Practice language for invitation, arrival, congratulations, participation, thanks, and departure.

ruleBlocks.title: Learn occasions with event actions
ruleBlocks.content: Connect Geburtstag feiern, zur Hochzeit einladen, ein Geschenk mitbringen, and eine Party organisieren.

ruleBlocks.title: State calendar dates clearly
ruleBlocks.content: Use ordinal forms in date chunks: am ersten Mai, am zwölften Juni, vom dritten bis zum fünften August.

ruleBlocks.title: Read the complete invitation
ruleBlocks.content: Find the occasion, host, date, time, place, response deadline, and any request about food, clothing, or gifts.

ruleBlocks.title: Distinguish positive and negative rules
ruleBlocks.content: Use instructions such as 'Bitte Schuhe ausziehen' and prohibitions such as 'Hier nicht rauchen'.

tables.title: Dates and Event Rules
rows: Die Feier ist am zwölften Juni.
Bitte bringt etwas zu trinken mit.
Stellt die Geschenke auf den Tisch.
Bitte raucht nicht in der Wohnung.

sentenceStructure: Separable event verbs split in main clauses.
Instructions commonly begin with the action or polite 'bitte'.
Put a location phrase after the item or action when explaining event setup.

comparisons.summary: The grammar lesson provides command forms and basic placement language for event rules.
The communication lesson supplies good wishes and natural responses for each occasion.

examples.de: Mein Geburtstag ist am dreiundzwanzigsten September.
Wir laden euch am Samstag um 18 Uhr zu unserer Feier ein.
examples.en: We invite you to our celebration on Saturday at 6 p.m.

examples.de: Soll ich ein Geschenk oder etwas zu essen mitbringen?
examples.en: Should I bring a gift or something to eat?

examples.de: Bitte stellt die Getränke in den Kühlschrank.
examples.en: Please put the drinks in the refrigerator.

examples.de: In diesem Raum dürft ihr nicht rauchen.
examples.en: You may not smoke in this room.

commonMistakes.reason: Spoken dates use an ordinal form after 'am'.
'Einladen' is separable in a main clause.

commonMistakes.correct: Add the date, time, place, and response information.

specialCases: Ordinal endings vary by grammatical context; this lesson prioritizes fixed date chunks after 'am'.
Customs around gifts, punctuality, shoes, and food vary by event and community.
'Feier' is a general celebration; 'Party' is common but often more informal.
tips: Create a complete invitation for a real or fictional event.
Sort event statements into invitation detail, custom, instruction, or prohibition.

sourceStyle.origin: LangCompass editorial lesson aligned to the Momente A1.2 M5 catalog topic
sourceStyle.notes: The lesson treats celebrations as a sequence of invitation details, participation, and rules.
